verdict.rationale: Heap documents a server-side Bulk Track endpoint that accepts an events array of up to 1000 events per request, alongside a server-side track API for custom events. That is a first-party bulk event-ingestion capability a developer could use to load exported data. However, nothing in the evidence shows it accepts historical timestamps for backfill, or that Heap offers a dedicated importer from other analytics tools or file exports. Missing for 10: documented historical/backdated timestamp support, a migration/import path from other analytics tools, file-based (e.g. CSV) event import, and independent or hands-on corroboration of backfilling.
